name: Plenoxel Data Structure
definition: A sparse data structure for storing radiance fields consisting of a dense pointer grid and a sparse data table. Each cell in the dense pointer grid is either NULL or a pointer into the data table. Each entry in the data table stores the density value ($\sigma$) and the Spherical Harmonic (SH) coefficients for each of the RGB color channels. NULL cells are treated as having all zero values.
summary: Plenoxel is a sparse 3D grid for view synthesis storing opacity and spherical harmonic coefficients, distinguished by its discrete voxel structure with trilinear interpolation.
